name: Ceramic rainscreen
summary: A wall skin of hollow clay panels on rails, with an air gap behind. The panels keep rain off the wall, and the air dries it.
how: Extrude the panel hollow in a die, with a wall of 15 to 30 mm.
Fire the panel once, with an engobe or a glaze if the design needs it.
Hang each panel on a clip and a rail of stainless steel.
Keep an air gap of 20 to 50 mm and an open joint of 6 to 10 mm.

origin.note: German makers extrude hollow terracotta panels for hung, ventilated facades.

adoptions.via: Architects use extruded terracotta panels on rails for offices, schools and museums in northern Europe.
